definitions.gloss: to be finalized, to be decided
definitions.explanation: For plans or decisions to become fixed.

examples.japanese: セメントが{固|かた}まった。
{緊張|きんちょう}で{体|からだ}が{固|かた}まった。
{接着剤|せっちゃくざい}が{固|かた}まった。
{予定|よてい}が{固|かた}まった。
{方針|ほうしん}が{固|かた}まった。
{決意|けつい}が{固|かた}まって、{留学|りゅうがく}することにした。
examples.english: My resolve was set, and I decided to study abroad.

notes:
{固|かた}まる is an intransitive godan verb meaning to harden, solidify, or become fixed. It covers both physical hardening and abstract finalization.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {固|かた}める (transitive — to harden something, to solidify)

ASPECT (ている):
{固|かた}まっている means "is hardened" or "is set" — the resulting state after solidification.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- セメントが{固|かた}まる: cement hardens
- {予定|よてい}が{固|かた}まる: plans are finalized
- {決意|けつい}が{固|かた}まる: one's resolve is set
- {体|からだ}が{固|かた}まる: body stiffens (from tension or fear)
- {考|かんが}えが{固|かた}まる: ideas take shape / become firm

USAGE:
Physical hardening (cement, glue, clay), abstract finalization (plans, decisions, opinions), and emotional/bodily stiffening (from nervousness or shock) are all natural uses.
